description: Alteration of an existing window and insertion of an additional front window with internal alterations to reconfigure the second floor bedroom and bathroom facilities of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Heritage Statement, EX001, PR002, PR003, Unnumbered Site Location Plan and PR004) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The new internal panelling shall match the proportions and profiles of the existing panelling. The existing ironmongery and door furniture from doors, cupboards and panelling that is to be removed (e.g. handles and hinges) shall be retained on site and re-used in furnishing the new

Condition : 5 - The profile of the new side window joinery shall match the cross sections and dimensions of all sashes and casements, transoms, mullions and glazing bars of the existing front sash windows, save for any necessary increase in depth of the glazing bars and frames required to accommodate the approved sealed double glazing.
